raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Under `--dcp-size c`, DSA (GLM-5.3 / DeepSeek-V3.2 style) extend chunks take the decode-style path: per layer, Q is all-gathered to all heads, each rank attends over its owned top-k slice, and the partial outputs + LSE are exchanged with an all-to-all. For an 8192-token chunk that is ~0.8 GB of NVLink traffic per rank per layer with no overlap. Measured on 4xB300 with GLM-5.3 NVFP4: DCP4 prefill runs at 14-15k tok/s vs 22-25k tok/s for plain TP4, and on the AgentX c48 point prefill batches take ~69% of wall time even at a 97% cache hit rate.

## Change

Behind `SGLANG_ENABLE_DSA_DCP_EXTEND_GATHER_KV=1` (default off, no behavior change otherwise): DSA extend under DCP keeps the plain 16-head path, and inside the TRT-LLM DSA forward each layer all-gathers the striped latent prefix rows of the batch into a position-ordered scratch buffer that the sparse kernel reads directly (`dsa_dcp_gather.py`). One plan per extend batch (owned rows in position order, receive permutation, position page table, and a slot -> row map for the fused top-k output). No LSE merge, no Q gather, no page-table localization.

| 4xB300 NVFP4, 8k chunks | 32k prompt | 131k prompt |
|---|---|---|
| TP4 | 23-25k tok/s | 22k tok/s |
| TP4 + DCP4, today | 15.2k | 14.1k |
| TP4 + DCP4, this flag | 22.3k | 20.1k |

Profile (32k prompt, one rank): kernel busy 2,125 ms -> 1,790 ms (TP4: 1,292 ms); helix all-to-all, Q all-gather and their packing are gone, the remaining gap is the per-layer NCCL all-gather (latency-bound) and a slower TP all-reduce sharing the links.

## Status

Prototype. Still torch-level (index_select + NCCL all-gather per layer, no overlap); the fused pack/reorder kernels of #43515 apply to this buffer. The DCP2+MTP+HiCache KL kit run was interrupted by a devbox eviction after one prefill-hit sample read 0.0235 against the 0.02 threshold; re-validation pending before this leaves draft.

+"""Gather the DCP-striped latent KV of an extend batch into one position-ordered buffer per layer."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+
+class DcpGatherPlan(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    # Physical rows this rank contributes, in (request, position) order, padded to n_max.
+    send_rows: torch.Tensor
+    # Index into the [dcp_size * n_max] all-gather result for every (request, position).
+    recv_rows: torch.Tensor
+    # [bs, max_len] int32: row of position p of request b in the gathered buffer.
+    page_table: torch.Tensor
+    num_tokens: int
+    num_rows: int
+    # Widened slot -> gathered row for every slot of this batch (fused top-k emits slots).
+    slot_to_row: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def build_dcp_gather_plan(
+    *,
+    page_table: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens_cpu: torch.Tensor,
+    dcp_size: int,
+    dcp_rank: int,
+    physical_page_size: int,
+    slot_to_row: torch.Tensor,
+) -> DcpGatherPlan:
+    device = page_table.device
+    bs, max_len = page_table.shape
+    lens = seq_lens_cpu.to(torch.int64)
+    total = int(lens.sum())
+    base = (torch.cumsum(lens, 0) - lens).to(device)
+    req_idx = torch.repeat_interleave(torch.arange(bs), lens).to(device)
+    pos = torch.arange(total, device=device) - base[req_idx]
+    slots = page_table[req_idx, pos].to(torch.int64)
+    owner = slots % dcp_size
+    local_row = slots // dcp_size
+    # Owners alternate within every widened page, so no rank holds more than total / dcp + bs rows.
+    n_max = total // dcp_size + bs
+    order = torch.argsort(owner, stable=True)
+    counts = torch.bincount(owner, minlength=dcp_size)
+    starts = torch.cumsum(counts, 0) - counts
+    rank_index = torch.empty_like(owner)
+    rank_index[order] = torch.arange(total, device=device) - starts[owner[order]]
+    send_rows = torch.zeros(n_max + 1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    send_rows.scatter_(0, torch.where(owner == dcp_rank, rank_index, n_max), local_row)
+    recv_rows = owner * n_max + rank_index
+    gathered_table = (
+        base[:, None] + torch.arange(max_len, device=device)[None, :]
+    ).clamp_(max=total - 1)
+    num_rows = -(-total // physical_page_size) * physical_page_size
+    slot_to_row[slots] = torch.arange(total, device=device, dtype=slot_to_row.dtype)
+    return DcpGatherPlan(
+        send_rows=send_rows[:n_max],
+        recv_rows=recv_rows,
+        page_table=gathered_table.to(torch.int32),
+        num_tokens=total,
+        num_rows=num_rows,
+        slot_to_row=slot_to_row,
+    )
+
+
+def remap_slots_to_gathered_rows(
+    page_table_1: torch.Tensor, slot_to_row: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Fused top-k emits widened KV slots; translate them into gathered rows, keeping -1 padding."""
+    rows = slot_to_row[page_table_1.clamp(min=0).to(torch.int64)]
+    return torch.where(page_table_1 >= 0, rows.to(page_table_1.dtype), page_table_1)
+
+
+def gather_dcp_prefix_kv(
+    k_cache: torch.Tensor, plan: DcpGatherPlan, group, kv_cache_dim: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """All-gather every rank's owned rows and reorder them by position; returns [num_rows, kv_cache_dim]."""
+    rows = k_cache.view(-1, kv_cache_dim)
+    dtype = rows.dtype
+    rows = rows.view(torch.uint8)
+    send = rows.index_select(0, plan.send_rows)
+    recv = group.all_gather(send, dim=0)
+    out = torch.empty(
+        (plan.num_rows, rows.shape[1]), dtype=torch.uint8, device=rows.device
+    )
+    torch.index_select(recv, 0, plan.recv_rows, out=out[: plan.num_tokens])
+    return out.view(dtype)

+"""The DCP gather plan reorders every rank's owned rows into position order and remaps top-k slots."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.dsa_dcp_gather import (
+    build_dcp_gather_plan,
+    remap_slots_to_gathered_rows,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+DCP = 4
+PAGE = 64
+ROWS = 2048
+
+
+def _random_widened_table(rng, bs):
+    """Each request takes whole widened pages (64 * DCP consecutive slots) at random page ids."""
+    lens = torch.tensor([int(rng.integers(1, 600)) for _ in range(bs)])
+    table = torch.full((bs, int(lens.max())), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    free_pages = list(rng.permutation(ROWS * DCP // (PAGE * DCP)))
+    for b in range(bs):
+        pos = 0
+        while pos < int(lens[b]):
+            page = int(free_pages.pop())
+            n = min(PAGE * DCP, int(lens[b]) - pos)
+            table[b, pos : pos + n] = torch.arange(
+                page * PAGE * DCP, page * PAGE * DCP + n
+            )
+            pos += n
+    return table, lens
+
+
+class TestDcpGatherPlan(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_gather_matches_owner_rule(self):
+        rng = __import__("numpy").random.default_rng(0)
+        rank_rows = [
+            torch.randint(0, 255, (ROWS, 8), dtype=torch.uint8) for _ in range(DCP)
+        ]
+        for _ in range(20):
+            table, lens = _random_widened_table(rng, bs=int(rng.integers(1, 5)))
+            slot_maps = [
+                torch.full((ROWS * DCP,), -1, dtype=torch.int32) for _ in range(DCP)
+            ]
+            plans = [
+                build_dcp_gather_plan(
+                    page_table=table,
+                    seq_lens_cpu=lens,
+                    dcp_size=DCP,
+                    dcp_rank=r,
+                    physical_page_size=PAGE,
+                    slot_to_row=slot_maps[r],
+                )
+                for r in range(DCP)
+            ]
+            n_max = plans[0].send_rows.numel()
+            recv = torch.cat(
+                [rank_rows[r].index_select(0, plans[r].send_rows) for r in range(DCP)]
+            )
+            for r in range(DCP):
+                plan = plans[r]
+                out = torch.empty((plan.num_rows, 8), dtype=torch.uint8)
+                torch.index_select(recv, 0, plan.recv_rows, out=out[: plan.num_tokens])
+                t = 0
+                for b in range(table.shape[0]):
+                    for pos in range(int(lens[b])):
+                        slot = int(table[b, pos])
+                        self.assertTrue(
+                            torch.equal(out[t], rank_rows[slot % DCP][slot // DCP])
+                        )
+                        self.assertEqual(int(plan.page_table[b, pos]), t)
+                        self.assertEqual(int(plan.slot_to_row[slot]), t)
+                        t += 1
+                self.assertEqual(plan.num_rows % PAGE, 0)
+                self.assertLess(int(plan.recv_rows.max()), DCP * n_max)
+
+    def test_remap_keeps_padding(self):
+        slot_to_row = torch.full((64,), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+        slot_to_row[torch.tensor([5, 9, 13])] = torch.tensor(
+            [0, 1, 2], dtype=torch.int32
+        )
+        topk = torch.tensor([[13, -1, 5, 9, -1]], dtype=torch.int32)
+        out = remap_slots_to_gathered_rows(topk, slot_to_row)
+        self.assertEqual(out.tolist(), [[2, -1, 0, 1, -1]])
+        self.assertEqual(out.dtype, torch.int32)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
